task_title: logsey watch serves /metrics on loopback :9162 + staleness alert signals
task_criteria: ACs: a Go /metrics endpoint on 127.0.0.1:9162 served from inside the logsey watch loop using client_golang/promhttp; curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9162/metrics | grep -c '^logsey_' >= 10 while watch runs; families per h3 docs/observability-spec.md section 5.2: logsey_watch_up, logsey_watch_tick_age_seconds, logsey_watch_tick_total, logsey_ingest_lines_total{source_class}, logsey_ingest_parse_errors_total{source_class}, logsey_ingest_lag_bytes{source}, logsey_source_suspended{source}, logsey_source_failure_runs{source}, logsey_corpus_bytes{format}, logsey_index_stale; tick_age reuses the exact staleness arithmetic from internal/cli/status_cmd.go (no reimplementation); a textfile completion record per tick written atomically (tmp+rename) so logsey_watch_up==0 is still observable after the process is gone; checkpoint last_tick and logsey_watch_tick_age_seconds agree within 5s; existing go build/vet/test/lint gates stay green; the running system daemon is not restarted and root/user-logsey-owned /var/lib/logsey is not touched
